disclosed_matters.topic: S/MIME NCP non ASCII symbols in email and SAN field wrong coding
disclosed_matters.summary: SwissSign AG issued S/MIME NCP certificates with incorrect coding of non-ASCII symbols in email and SAN fields; remediation measures were verified and properly addressed.
SwissSign AG had findings identified in the 2024 audit; remediation measures were verified and properly addressed.
SwissSign S/MIME certificates deviated from the Certificate Practice Rules; remediation measures were verified and properly addressed.
SwissSign S/MIME LCP certificates contained not-permitted key usage; remediation measures were verified and properly addressed.
